propositions: The Responses API is the default for openai: in pydantic-ai v2 but rebar must prove compatibility before migrating from the explicitly-pinned Chat Completions API.

Hosted OpenAI (openai: / openai-chat:) supports Responses API at the pydantic-ai layer but is blocked by four rebar code sites: KNOWN_PROVIDER_NAMES missing openai-responses, _pydantic_ai_known_providers deriving incomplete entries, _PROFILE_RESOLVERS lacking openai-responses key, and hardcoded openai: → openai-chat: normalizers.

Custom base_url endpoints (LMStudio/Ollama/vLLM/LiteLLM via ProviderSession._build_openai) and per-candidate endpoint overrides are Chat-Completions-only because builders register only for openai/openai-chat qualifiers.

Third-party OpenAI-compatible providers (deepseek, grok, xai, groq, cerebras, moonshotai, heroku, gateway/openai) offer no Responses construction path under pydantic-ai 1.107.2 pin; vendor-side /v1/responses support is UNKNOWN without live API evidence.

Contract tests in test_openai_responses_contract.py validate structured-output, streaming, tool-call, 429-retry, and custom-base-URL behavior identically across openai-chat: and openai-responses: prefixes using real pydantic-ai model construction with MockTransport.

Production migration for 155c requires edits to four rebar constraint sites (config.py, providers.py, capabilities.py, model-class normalizers) before openai-responses: becomes usable in runner.run().
